name: gizza-ai/http-request-builder
summary: Build a raw HTTP/1.1 request message

tool.description: Build a well-formed raw HTTP/1.1 request message from a method, URL, headers, and body. NOTHING is sent — it just produces the text you'd put on the wire (e.g. for netcat/openssl s_client, teaching, or debugging). The request-target and Host come from the URL; headers are one 'Name: Value' per line; a Content-Length is added for a body. Lines are CRLF-terminated. To actually send a request, use the http-request tool.

url.description: The request URL (used for the request-target and Host header).

headers.description: Optional request headers, one 'Name: Value' per line. Host is added from the URL if omitted.

body.description: Optional request body. A Content-Length header is added automatically when a body is given.
